# Chresten Gamborg Puggaard

Chresten Gamborg Puggaard is identified in the AFDK annual report as Cand. polit. and Datamanager (data manager) for RKKP, working on behalf of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. He appears in a section of the report (pages 66-70) that lists the members of the database's steering group, alongside content on patient education perspectives and methodological limitations of the database [^src1].

Chresten Gamborg Puggaard is mentioned once in the corpus, listed as a member of the AFDK steering group with the title Cand. polit., Datamanager, RKKP [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or claims are available.
